_notes: Config for `pnpm optimize`. Ranges are [min, max]; a { "values": [...] } entry allows only those settings.
weights: relative importance of each axis's span. These favour a ride / flight-style base: roll, pitch, heave.
rodLength: set the range to what your threaded rod + ball ends can actually make (ball centre to ball centre).
hornLength values: the radii of the holes on your horn (placeholder until measured).
servoTorqueKgCm x torqueSafety is the most torque a design may ask a servo to hold.
variants: each one fixes some parameters, so you can compare build effort against gain.
minClearanceMm: gap kept between servo bodies during the search (room for mounts and cables); overrides the rig's collision.minClearance.
